options_considered: expose only Class-A bitemporal tables (per EXISTING_PATTERNS_AUDIT.md)
expose ts.*, ref.*, doc.*, kap.*, agg.* with one PIT function per resource
decisions.chosen: ts.*, ref.entity, ref.identifier, doc.filing, kap.disclosures, agg.filing_event — each via a PIT SQL function and a thin REST layer
decisions.rationale: Bitemporal logic concentrates in SQL functions (testable in SQL, reusable by SDK and tools); only fact tables and identifier-bearing tables are exposed.

options_considered: expose temporal SQL:2011 'FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF' surface
decisions.chosen: PIT (?as_of=T), interval (?as_of_range=[T1,T2)), current (?as_of=NOW(); default if omitted)
decisions.rationale: PIT and current cover 95% of research workloads; interval supports change-detection and amendment analysis (the Moat 2 canary itself uses interval queries).

decisions.chosen: as_of derived from COALESCE(body_fetched_at, index_fetched_at, published_at) with as_of_provenance enum; NULL when none available; default API queries exclude NULL rows; ?include_pre_bitemporal=true surfaces them with metadata.pre_bitemporal=true
decisions.rationale: Surfacing NULL is honest about uncertainty; sentinels propagate silently through aggregations and break Moat 2's contract.

decisions.chosen: REST + OpenAPI 3.1
decisions.rationale: Auto-generated docs (Swagger/ReDoc), straightforward SDK generation, matches existing aslan-core API patterns. PostgREST rejected because the API has non-trivial business logic (rate limits, audit log, FF gating, pre-bitemporal handling).
decisions.consumer_visibility: OpenAPI 3.1 at /v1/research/openapi.json; Swagger UI at /v1/research/docs; ReDoc at /v1/research/redoc

decisions.chosen: Long-lived API keys (UUID + 32-byte secret) hashed argon2id; per-key rate tier; per-key pii_unredacted scope; expires_at default +1y
decisions.rationale: API keys are simplest to audit; match aslan-event-extractor compliance posture; defer JWT/OAuth/mTLS until enterprise demands it.

decisions.chosen: Three tiers (internal/partner/public); per-key overrides via aslan_core.api_key.rate_overrides JSONB; Postgres-backed token bucket
decisions.rationale: Simple defaults that fit common access patterns; per-key overrides handle edge cases without a tier explosion.

decisions.chosen: Cursor-based: opaque base64 JSON of {v, as_of, anchor, direction, filters_hash}; default limit 50, max 500
decisions.rationale: Monotonic under bitemporal append; uses the underlying (entity, as_of) index efficiently; filters_hash prevents cursor reuse across filter sets.
decisions.consumer_visibility: next_cursor / prev_cursor in response envelope; cursor opaque to clients
evidence: Postgres keyset-pagination patterns; ref.identifier PIT pattern

decisions.topic: TAS 29 restated financials handling under as_of
decisions.chosen: New as_of row in ts.canonical_financial with restatement_kind='tas29' tag; restatement_chain materialized view walks the chain
decisions.rationale: TAS 29 is workspace Moat 5; in-place restatement would break Moat 2.
decisions.default_state: false until Phase 2; true after Phase 2j gate; true on prod after Phase 7

options_considered: use existing ref.identifier daterange + GiST EXCLUDE
decisions.chosen: Use existing ref.identifier; API endpoint resolves (namespace, value, as_of) via daterange @> as_of
decisions.rationale: Existing schema is bitemporal-correct; no new discipline needed.

decisions.chosen: New ref.entity row with later as_of and merged_from_entity_ids JSONB; ref.entity_lineage row recording the merge event
decisions.rationale: Allows PIT before-merge queries to see pre-merge structure; lineage table enables audit/replay.
decisions.default_state: false until Phase 2; true after Phase 2 gate
decisions.consumer_visibility: merged_from_entity_ids field on Entity schema; ref.entity_lineage exposed via /entities/{id}/lineage in v2

decisions.chosen: New (disclosure_id, as_of) row on republish; append-only trigger blocks UPDATE
decisions.rationale: Amendment chains are the load-bearing case for Moat 2 — exactly what the canary tests.
decisions.default_state: false until Phase 2c; true after Phase 2j gate; true on prod after Phase 7

decisions.chosen: microsecond (Postgres timestamptz native)
decisions.rationale: Native precision; finer would require a separate as_of_seq column with no benefit at our write rate.
decisions.consumer_visibility: ISO8601 with microseconds in API responses

options_considered: UTC at storage + UTC in API
UTC at storage + Europe/Istanbul in API
decisions.chosen: UTC at storage; API responses always UTC ISO8601 with Z; optional ?display_tz=IANA adds local_time companion field
decisions.rationale: UTC discipline upstream; naive datetimes raise; display_tz is convenience without changing semantics.
decisions.consumer_visibility: ISO8601 with Z; optional local_time field per row

decisions.topic: NULL vs sentinel for unknown as_of
decisions.chosen: NULL; no sentinel
decisions.rationale: Per ADR-002 the platform does not fabricate data; sentinels propagate silently through aggregations; NULL is loud.
decisions.consumer_visibility: documented in /v1/research/disclosures and elsewhere where pre-bitemporal rows exist

decisions.chosen: data + metadata envelope with as_of_requested, as_of_resolved, lineage, pagination, feature_flags_active, warnings, request_id, served_by
decisions.rationale: Lineage and as_of metadata in every response is the audit-trail contract from ADR-003 replayability.

decisions.chosen: RFC 7807 application/problem+json; machine-readable code field added; extensions for error-specific structure
decisions.rationale: Standard, stable, widely supported by client tooling.

options_considered: immutable for past + ETag for current
decisions.chosen: Immutable Cache-Control for as_of <= NOW()-5min (ETag = sha256 body); no-cache + ETag for current/recent
decisions.rationale: Past as_of responses are immutable by Moat 2; immutable cache is a major perf lever and CDN-friendly. 5-minute window absorbs late-arriving extraction events.
decisions.consumer_visibility: Cache-Control, ETag headers documented in OpenAPI

decisions.chosen: aslan_core.api_query_audit table; 13-month retention; query params hashed (raw params PII-risky); request_id for correlation
decisions.rationale: Required for SOC II + GDPR; 'who-asked-what-at-when' answerable; hashing keeps log free of incidental PII.
decisions.consumer_visibility: internal table; not exposed via API in v1

decisions.chosen: Multi-dimensional: as_of_range <=5y, page<=500, distinct entity_ids<=100, OR-clauses<=10, statement_timeout 30s, response<=10MiB; per-key overrides
decisions.rationale: p99 <=100ms target is single-entity PIT only; bulk queries pay via lower-priority queues in v2.
decisions.consumer_visibility: QUERY_TOO_LARGE error code documented in OpenAPI

decisions.topic: Moat 2 regression as public verification endpoint
decisions.chosen: /v1/verify/moat-2 unauthenticated; 200 green or 503 red; cached 60s server-side
decisions.rationale: Moat is verifiable by anyone (customers, journalists, regulators) — not just internal monitoring.

decisions.chosen: Swagger UI at /v1/research/docs; ReDoc at /v1/research/redoc; raw OpenAPI at /v1/research/openapi.json; customer-facing prose at docs/specs/.../README.md
decisions.rationale: Swagger for exploration; ReDoc for static; raw JSON for SDK generation.

decisions.chosen: Python SDK first-class (aslan_research_sdk); other languages on demand per ADR-002
decisions.rationale: Python is the platform language; internal services consume via SDK first; non-Python SDKs need maintenance plans before merging.
decisions.consumer_visibility: SDK package on internal PyPI / aslan-core/sdk/python

decisions.chosen: Path-based major (/v1/research/); minor versions backward-compatible additions
decisions.rationale: Simplest mental model; matches existing aslan-dashboard-api routes.

decisions.chosen: Deprecation header + Sunset header + OpenAPI deprecated=true + CHANGELOG entry; minimum 6 months between announcement and removal
decisions.rationale: Industry-standard headers + project CHANGELOG; 6 months gives clients quarterly cadence.
decisions.consumer_visibility: Deprecation, Sunset response headers when applicable

decisions.chosen: Prometheus on :9001/metrics; OTel traces to existing collector; structlog with request_id correlation
decisions.rationale: Match existing aslan-core observability; do not invent.
decisions.consumer_visibility: internal dashboards; no API surface change

decisions.chosen: New router aslan_core.api.routes.research mounted at /v1/research/; existing routes unchanged
decisions.rationale: Existing routes have other consumers (dashboard, etc.); changing semantics under feet is out of scope.

decisions.chosen: Router in aslan-dashboard-api FastAPI process behind master flag BITEMPORAL_API_ENABLED
decisions.rationale: Single-process simplest at v1 RPS; Postgres is the bottleneck not FastAPI; v2 can split without API surface change.

decisions.chosen: aslan_core.bitemporal_table_registry table + CI check scripts/check_bitemporal_table_registry.py enforcing every as_of-bearing table has a registry row
decisions.rationale: Without enforcement, bitemporal discipline drifts silently as new tables ship.
decisions.consumer_visibility: internal CI; not exposed via API

options_considered: unit + integration + regression + fuzz + load + canary + replay
decisions.chosen: Unit (pytest, testcontainers Postgres) + integration + regression (Moat 2 canary >=10 cases) + fuzz (Hypothesis on as_of parsing/cursor/auth) + load (locust 100 RPS, p99 <=100ms target) + replay (>=10 random agg.filing_event rows reconstructed from raw bytes)
decisions.rationale: Defense-in-depth; schema-level append-only contract tested both via positive trigger and via negative bypass attempts.

options_considered: default redacted with per-key pii_unredacted scope
decisions.chosen: Default redacted (<REDACTED:reason>); per-key pii_unredacted scope; redaction events themselves bitemporal (PIT before redaction returns unredacted; after returns redacted); audit log captures every PII access; 13-month retention; EU-only routing (Hetzner DE)
decisions.rationale: Compliance is schema-level not retrofit; matches aslan-event-extractor/SCOPE.md §6 posture; PIT before redaction must return original to honor Moat 2.
decisions.default_state: false (must be deliberately enabled per environment)
decisions.consumer_visibility: <REDACTED:reason> tokens in PII fields when not authorized
